1. (Currently Amended) A method comprising: a processor determining that a benefit payment is due to be made to a recipient; the processor accessing a data store containing records of payment transactions made by the recipient; the processor receiving an indication from the data store that the recipient had successfully performed a biometric user authentication with respect to at least one of the payment transactions; the processor accepting the received indication as proof-of-life with respect to the recipient; and the processor making the benefit payment to the recipient in response to said proof-of-life, wherein the method includes at least one additional technological step beyond the abstract idea of authenticating a recipient and making a payment, comprising: __the processor verifying that the biometric user authentication was performed using a secure hardware element of a mobile device, and the processor cross-referencing the biometric authentication data with a government-issued identification database to confirm the recipient's identity before making the benefit payment__.

2. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1, wherein said at least one payment transaction occurred during a pre-determined period of time prior to said accessing step, and wherein __the processor automatically flags transactions occurring outside the pre-determined period for manual review before authorizing the benefit payment__.

3. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 2, wherein said pre-determined period of time is seven days, and wherein __the processor generates a timestamped audit log of all biometric authentications within the seven-day period__.

4. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 2, wherein said pre-determined period of time is 24 hours, and wherein __the processor generates a timestamped audit log of all biometric authentications within the 24-hour period__.

5. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1, wherein the benefit payment is a social insurance transfer payment, and wherein __the processor verifies the recipient's eligibility status in a government benefits database before authorizing the payment__.

6. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1, wherein the at least one of the payment transactions includes a credit card account transaction and/or a debit card account transaction, and wherein __the processor validates the payment transaction through a financial institution's fraud detection system__.

7. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 6, wherein a mobile device was used by the recipient to initiate the at least one payment transaction, and wherein __the processor verifies that the mobile device's geolocation is consistent with the recipient's known residence or recent transaction history__.

8. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1, wherein the benefit payment is made via an electronic monetary transfer to an account owned by the recipient, and wherein __the processor encrypts the transfer using a secure communication protocol and logs the transaction in an immutable ledger__.

9. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1, wherein the benefit payment is made by sending a check to the recipient, and wherein __the processor generates a tracking record and notifies the recipient of the check's mailing date and expected delivery date__.

10. (Currently Amended) A method comprising: a processor determining that a benefit payment is due to be made to a recipient; the processor accessing, at a first point in time, a data store containing records of payment transactions made by the recipient; the processor determining that the data store contains an indication that the recipient had successfully performed a biometric user authentication most recently with respect to one of said payment transactions at a second point in time earlier than the first point in time; the processor comparing a time interval defined by the second and first points in time with a pre-determined permissive time interval; the processor making the benefit payment, without requiring proof-of-life authentication of the recipient, in a case where the time interval defined by the second and first points in time does not exceed the pre-determined permissive time interval; and the processor requiring proof-of-life authentication of the recipient, prior to making the benefit payment, in a case where the time interval defined by the second and first points in time exceeds the pre-determined permissive time interval, wherein the method includes at least one additional technological step beyond the abstract idea of authenticating a recipient and making a payment, comprising: __the processor verifying that the biometric user authentication was performed using a secure hardware element of a mobile device, and the processor cross-referencing the biometric authentication data with a government-issued identification database to confirm the recipient's identity before making the benefit payment__.

11. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 10, wherein the pre-determined permissive time interval is seven days, and wherein __the processor generates a timestamped audit log of all biometric authentications within the seven-day period__.

12. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 10, wherein the pre-determined permissive time interval is 24 hours, and wherein __the processor generates a timestamped audit log of all biometric authentications within the 24-hour period__.

13. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 10, wherein the benefit payment is a social insurance transfer payment, and wherein __the processor verifies the recipient's eligibility status in a government benefits database before authorizing the payment__.

14. (Currently Amended) An apparatus comprising: a processor; and a memory in communication with the processor, the memory storing program instructions, the processor operative with the program instructions to perform functions as follows: determining that a benefit payment is due to be made to a recipient; accessing a data store containing records of payment transactions made by the recipient; receiving an indication from the data store that the recipient had successfully performed a biometric user authentication with respect to at least one of the payment transactions; accepting the received indication as proof-of-life with respect to the recipient; and making the benefit payment to the recipient in response to said proof-of-life, wherein the processor is further operative to: __verify that the biometric user authentication was performed using a secure hardware element of a mobile device, and cross-reference the biometric authentication data with a government-issued identification database to confirm the recipient's identity before making the benefit payment__.

15. (Currently Amended) The apparatus of claim 14, wherein said at least one payment transaction occurred during a pre-determined period of time prior to said accessing, and wherein __the processor is further operative to automatically flag transactions occurring outside the pre-determined period for manual review before authorizing the benefit payment__.

16. (Currently Amended) The apparatus of claim 15, wherein said pre-determined period of time is seven days, and wherein __the processor is further operative to generate a timestamped audit log of all biometric authentications within the seven-day period__.

17. (Currently Amended) The apparatus of claim 15, wherein said pre-determined period of time is 24 hours, and wherein __the processor is further operative to generate a timestamped audit log of all biometric authentications within the 24-hour period__.

18. (Currently Amended) The apparatus of claim 14, wherein the benefit payment is a social insurance transfer payment, and wherein __the processor is further operative to verify the recipient's eligibility status in a government benefits database before authorizing the payment__.

19. (Currently Amended) The apparatus of claim 14, wherein the at least one of the payment transactions includes a credit card account transaction and/or a debit card account transaction, and wherein __the processor is further operative to validate the payment transaction through a financial institution's fraud detection system__.

20. (Currently Amended) The apparatus of claim 19, wherein a mobile device was used by the recipient to initiate the at least one payment transaction, and wherein __the processor is further operative to verify that the mobile device's geolocation is consistent with the recipient's known residence or recent transaction history__.
